summary: The assemble module concatenates a directory of fragment files, in string sort order, into a single destination file, which helps for programs that lack conf.d support.
questions: How do I build one config file from several snippet files?
My app doesn't support conf.d; how can Ansible combine fragments?
In what order does assemble join files?
Can assemble use fragments already on the remote host?

answer_card.title: Build config files from fragments with assemble
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.assemble` concatenates all files in a directory (local or already on the target) into one `dest` file. Files are joined in **string sort order**, so name them like `10-base`, `20-extra`. Useful for programs without `conf.d` support.
